title: PointCast: One World Model for Rigid, Articulated, and Deformable Object Manipulation
summary: World models are useful for robotic manipulation because robots can predict how actions change the states of objects before executing them. We present PointCast, a point-set world model that spans rigid, articulated, and deformable object manipulation. Its state is a set of 3D points on the object and the end-effector, mesh-free and topology-agnostic. Each point keeps its identity and is supervised on its own trajectory, which teaches the model where every point goes rather than only the shape the points form. Its backbone is a diffusion transformer that denoises a short window of future point positions, conditioned on the points' recent history and the commanded end-effector motion. The backbone's attention alternates between local and global, and cross-attention to the end-effector carries the coupling. This one architecture at 19.8M parameters and one training recipe cover four regimes, rigid objects, cloth, rope, and multi-joint cabinets, with a separate checkpoint trained for each. Trained on randomized simulation and scored against four baselines on the same metric, it is best on three of four regimes and second on rigid. Trained on a real-world robot teleoperation dataset, it has the lowest mean error in four of its six categories, is second in the other two, and improves on the dataset's own model in all six; zero-shot, its simulation checkpoints are best on two of four captures. Frozen inside sampling-based model-predictive control at one network evaluation per window, it plans four simulated tasks over 64 episodes, competitive with or outperforming every baseline on each. Project website at https://pointcast-wm.github.io.
tldr: PointCast is a point-set world model for robotic manipulation that predicts future point trajectories for rigid, articulated, and deformable objects, enabling model-predictive control across diverse tasks.
tldr_zh: PointCast 是一种用于机器人操作的点集世界模型，通过预测刚体、关节体和可变形物体上点的未来轨迹，支持跨多种任务的模型预测控制。
summary_zh: 世界模型对于机器人操作非常有用，因为机器人可以在执行动作之前预测动作如何改变物体的状态。我们提出PointCast，一个点集世界模型，涵盖刚体、铰接体和可变形物体的操作。其状态是物体和末端执行器上的一组3D点，无需网格且与拓扑无关。每个点保持其身份，并针对其自身轨迹进行监督，这教会模型每个点的去向，而不仅仅是点所形成的形状。其主干是一个扩散Transformer，它对未来点位置的短窗口进行去噪，条件是该点的近期历史和所指令的末端执行器运动。主干的注意力在局部和全局之间交替，对末端执行器的交叉注意力承载耦合。这一架构具有1980万参数和单一训练方案，覆盖四种场景：刚体、布料、绳子和多关节柜体，每种场景训练单独的检查点。在随机化仿真上训练，并在相同指标下与四个基线进行比较，它在四种场景中的三种表现最佳，在刚体场景中排名第二。在真实世界机器人遥操作数据集上训练，它在六个类别中的四个类别中平均误差最低，在两个类别中排名第二，并在所有六个类别中优于数据集自身的模型；零样本情况下，其仿真检查点在四次捕捉中的两次表现最佳。在基于采样的模型预测控制中冻结使用，每个窗口进行一次网络评估，它在64个回合中规划四个仿真任务，与每个基线相比具有竞争力或表现更好。项目网站为https://pointcast-wm.github.io。

title: Beyond Future Prediction: Denoising as Generative Adaptation for Robot Control
summary: Pretrained generative Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) capture rich pixel-level visual and language-conditioned structure through large-scale image and video generation training. A growing line of robot policies builds on this generative prior, but how it should be transferred to control remains unclear, and existing approaches commonly instantiate this transfer through future visual prediction. We ask a more basic question: what a pretrained generative DiT actually contributes to action learning, and how this prior should be adapted for control. We introduce NowWAM, a future-target-free co-training formulation that denoises the current observation and predicts robot actions from the same visual stream, directly coupling the native generative objective to the action-facing representation across the denoising trajectory. Under matched controlled settings, past and future visual targets perform comparably, while restricting training to the clean endpoint substantially reduces robustness, suggesting that a separate future target is not essential for generative adaptation, while the denoising trajectory remains an effective interface for control. On LIBERO-Plus, NowWAM reaches 87.7% with FLUX2-Klein, improving over the future-target co-training baseline by 6.1 points while halving training visual tokens (784 to 392) and reducing step time from 2.85 s to 1.63 s, a 1.8x speedup. With the pure text-to-image Z-Image backbone, NowWAM further reaches 87.8%, showing that strong control adaptation is not tied to video generation or image-editing backbones.
tldr: This paper introduces NowWAM, a novel co-training formulation that adapts pretrained generative diffusion transformers for robot control by denoising the current observation and predicting actions, without requiring future visual prediction, achieving state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus with improved efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了NowWAM，一种新颖的协同训练方法，通过去噪当前观测并预测动作来适应预训练的生成式扩散Transformer用于机器人控制，无需未来视觉预测，在LIBERO-Plus上取得了最优结果并提高了效率。
summary_zh: 预训练生成式扩散变换器（DiTs）通过大规模图像与视频生成训练，捕获了丰富的像素级视觉及语言条件结构。越来越多的机器人策略构建于这一生成先验之上，但其应如何迁移至控制任务仍不明确，且现有方法通常通过未来视觉预测来实现这一迁移。我们提出了一个更基本的问题：预训练生成式DiT实际上为动作学习贡献了什么，以及这一先验应如何适配控制任务。为此，我们引入了NowWAM，一种无需未来目标的协同训练框架，该框架从同一视觉流中对当前观测进行去噪并预测机器人动作，从而在去噪轨迹中直接将原生生成目标与面向动作的表征耦合。在受控的匹配设置下，过去与未来的视觉目标表现相当，而将训练限制在干净端点则会显著降低鲁棒性，这表明独立的未来目标并非生成式适配所必需，而去噪轨迹仍是控制的有效接口。在LIBERO-Plus基准上，NowWAM搭配FLUX2-Klein达到了87.7%的准确率，较未来目标协同训练基线提升了6.1个百分点，同时将训练视觉token数量减半（从784降至392），并将单步耗时从2.85秒缩短至1.63秒，实现了1.8倍的加速。在纯文本到图像骨干网络Z-Image上，NowWAM进一步达到87.8%的准确率，表明强控制适配并不依赖于视频生成或图像编辑骨干网络。

title: MemBodied: Recurrent Associative Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for general-purpose robot control, yet a vast majority of policies do not preserve and leverage episode-level information beyond the current observation. This limitation is consequential in history-dependent manipulation tasks that depend on information available only in past observations. Retaining past observations in context can aid in recovering this information, but at the significant cost of ever-growing, bloated context and inference latency. We thus introduce MemBodied, a fixed-size episodic memory with two complementary components: an associative state that records interactions across policy calls and an episode anchor that preserves a compact representation of the initial scene as a reference. At each policy call, the model conditions action generation on the current input and the memory components, rather than directly using past observations. Across five evaluated RMBench tasks requiring memory, MemBodied achieves $7.81\times$ the mean success rate of a stateless policy and $2.98\times$ of vanilla recurrent memory, while outperforming the strongest memory-augmented baseline by $1.3\times$ with $10\times$ fewer added parameters. On the fully observable LIBERO-Long suite, it reached 90.6%, a 5.4% improvement over the stateless $π_0$ policy. These findings support MemBodied as a practical alternative to expanding the policy context for history-dependent manipulation.
tldr: MemBodied introduces a fixed-size episodic memory for vision-language-action models, using an associative state and an episode anchor to improve history-dependent manipulation without bloating context. It achieves significant success-rate gains over stateless and recurrent baselines on RMBench and LIBERO-Long benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MemBodied 为视觉-语言-动作模型引入了一种固定大小的情节记忆，通过关联状态和情节锚点来改善依赖历史的操作任务，无需扩大上下文。在 RMBench 和 LIBERO-Long 基准上，相比无状态和循环基线取得了显著的成功率提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型为通用机器人控制提供了坚实基础，然而绝大多数策略在生成动作时并未保留或利用当前观测以外的回合级信息。这一局限在依赖过去观测中才可获得信息的历史相关操作任务中尤为关键。将过去的观测保留在上下文中有助于恢复此类信息，但代价是上下文不断膨胀以及推理延迟显著增加。为此，我们提出MemBodied，一种固定大小的情节记忆结构，包含两个互补组件：一个关联状态，用于记录策略调用之间的交互信息；以及一个情节锚点，用于保存初始场景的紧凑表示作为参考。在每次策略调用时，模型基于当前输入和记忆组件生成动作，而非直接使用过去的观测。在RMBench基准中五个需要记忆的任务上，MemBodied的平均成功率分别是无状态策略的$7.81\times$和朴素循环记忆的$2.98\times$，同时以少$10\times$的参数量超越最强记忆增强基线$1.3\times$。在完全可观测的LIBERO-Long套件上，其成功率达到了90.6%，较无状态$\pi_0$策略提升了5.4%。这些结果支持MemBodied作为扩展策略上下文以应对历史相关操作任务的一种实用替代方案。

title: Dissecting Advantage-Guided Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Advantage-guided reinforcement learning provides a practical way to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) policies using limited robot data. However, its performance depends on several coupled choices, including how critic-derived advantages are constructed, calibrated, and used for policy training. Existing recipes often combine these choices into a single end-to-end procedure, making their individual effects difficult to identify. In this work, we dissect advantage-guided VLA post-training through a controlled empirical study that separates these design choices while accounting for their distinct estimands. We develop stage-specific offline evaluation methods to screen alternative choices efficiently, without requiring extensive real-robot policy evaluations for every possible combination. The staged evaluation identifies a modular recipe that combines temporal-difference advantage construction, group-wise calibration, and continuous advantage weighting. Across four real-world bimanual tasks, the resulting recipe improves mean task progress and success over the SFT initialization by 0.42 and 0.63, respectively. Moreover, the proposed evaluation diagnostics show an overall alignment with downstream real-world performance, supporting their use for interpreting empirical outcomes and selecting advantage-guided post-training designs in practice.
tldr: This paper systematically dissects advantage-guided post-training for VLA policies, proposing stage-specific offline evaluations to isolate and identify a modular recipe (TD advantage construction, group-wise calibration, continuous weighting) that improves real-world bimanual manipulation performance.
tldr_zh: 本文系统分析了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的优势引导后训练，通过分阶段离线评估分离设计选择，提出了一种模块化方案（TD优势构造、分组校准、连续加权），在真实双臂操作任务中显著提升性能。
summary_zh: 优势引导的强化学习为利用有限的机器人数据对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略进行后训练提供了一种实用途径。然而，其性能依赖于若干相互耦合的选择，包括如何构造评论员派生的优势函数、对其进行校准以及将其用于策略训练。现有方案通常将这些选择合并为单一的端到端流程，导致难以辨识各因素的独立影响。在本工作中，我们通过一项受控实证研究对优势引导的VLA后训练进行剖析，在考虑各设计选择不同估计目标的前提下将其逐一分离。我们开发了分阶段的离线评估方法，以高效筛选备选方案，而无需对每一种可能组合进行大量的真实机器人策略评估。该分阶段评估识别出一种模块化方案，该方案结合了时序差分优势构造、分组校准和连续优势加权。在四项真实世界双臂任务中，所提方案相较于SFT初始化将平均任务进展和成功率分别提升了0.42和0.63。此外，所提出的评估诊断指标与下游真实世界性能总体一致，支持其在实际中用于解释实证结果和选择优势引导后训练设计。

title: Less Language, More Latents: Annotation-Efficient VLAs for Driving
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLA) promise human-steerable autonomous driving, but their training is bottlenecked by the scarcity of frames paired with natural-language instructions: while camera streams and expert trajectories are logged at scale, language annotations (e.g., turn left at the intersection) remain scarce and expensive to acquire. To address this challenge, we introduce Latent Action Driving Annotations (LADA), a three-stage pipeline that transforms abundant unlabelled observation-trajectory pairs into a substrate for language-conditioned control. First, we train a latent action model with a vector-quantised bottleneck, producing a compact codebook of high-level vehicle intents. Second, a small language-annotated subset is used to train a vision-language translator to map observations and language instructions into this codebook. Third, we train a driving VLA on observation-latent-action pairs over the full unlabelled corpus. Using fewer than 5% of language annotations and without leveraging any auxiliary chain-of-thought reasoning or visual question answering streams, LADA achieves a Driving Score of 87.98 and a Success Rate of 70.46% on the closed-loop Bench2Drive benchmark, matching or surpassing fully supervised baselines.
tldr: LADA introduces a three-stage pipeline to train driving Vision-Language-Action models using a latent action codebook, reducing language annotation requirements to under 5% while matching fully supervised performance on the closed-loop Bench2Drive benchmark.
tldr_zh: LADA通过三阶段流程利用潜在动作码本训练自动驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型，将语言标注需求降至5%以下，同时在闭环Bench2Drive基准上达到或超过全监督性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）有望实现可受人类操控的自动驾驶，但其训练受限于与自然语言指令配对的帧数据稀缺：尽管摄像头视频流和专家轨迹可以大规模记录，语言标注（例如“在交叉路口左转”）仍然稀少且获取成本高昂。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了潜在动作驾驶标注（LADA）方法，这是一个三阶段流水线，可将大量无标注的观测-轨迹配对数据转化为语言条件控制的基础。首先，我们训练一个带有向量量化瓶颈的潜在动作模型，生成高层车辆意图的紧凑码本。其次，利用一小部分带语言标注的子集训练一个视觉-语言翻译器，将观测和语言指令映射到该码本中。第三，我们在完整的无标注语料库上，基于观测-潜在动作对训练一个驾驶VLA模型。在仅使用不到5%的语言标注、且不借助任何辅助链式推理或视觉问答流的情况下，LADA在闭环Bench2Drive基准上取得了87.98的驾驶得分和70.46%的成功率，达到或超越了全监督基线方法的表现。

title: BEE: Intervention-Adaptive Real-World Reinforcement Learning with Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models handle long-horizon manipulation, yet success hinges on a few precision-critical phases where millimeter-scale errors undo all prior progress. Online reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize exactly these actions, but free exploration is far too costly on real robots, which makes human corrections indispensable. However, existing online RL methods for VLAs either cannot incorporate such corrections or fold them into undifferentiated supervision. Yet human corrections are not uniformly noisy but reliable along some action dimensions and variable along others. Building on this, we introduce BEE, an intervention-adaptive framework for real-world RL on a frozen VLA that lets the policy go BEyond Expert imitation. We formulate human corrections not as actions to reproduce but as evidence about a constraint: a Correction Model predicts how a human would correct a given VLA proposal and how consistent the correction is along each action dimension. This predicted consistency sets the per-dimension tightness of a constraint on policy optimization. Where corrections are consistent the policy stays close to the human, and where they vary, the constraint relaxes. We evaluate BEE on three real-world manipulation tasks and one LIBERO-Pro simulation task at a matched online-data budget. BEE attains the highest success rate on every task, 91.2% on average against 57.5% for RLT and 42.1% for DSRL, and the lowest human intervention rate on all real-world tasks.
tldr: BEE is an intervention-adaptive RL framework for frozen VLAs that models human corrections as per-dimension consistency constraints, achieving state-of-the-art success rates on real-world manipulation and simulation tasks.
tldr_zh: BEE 是一种针对冻结 VLA 的干预自适应强化学习框架，将人工修正建模为逐维度一致性约束，在真实世界操作和模拟任务中取得了最高成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够处理长时程操作任务，然而其成功往往取决于少数几个精度关键阶段，在这些阶段中，毫米级的误差会使此前所有的进展功亏一篑。在线强化学习（RL）能够精确优化这些关键动作，但在真实机器人上进行自由探索的成本过高，这使得人工纠正变得不可或缺。然而，现有的面向VLA的在线强化学习方法要么无法纳入此类纠正，要么将其混入无差异的监督信号中。事实上，人工纠正并非均匀噪声，而是沿某些动作维度可靠、沿其他维度可变。基于这一观察，我们提出了BEE，一种面向冻结VLA的干预自适应框架，用于真实世界强化学习，使策略能够超越专家模仿（BEyond Expert imitation）。我们不再将人工纠正视为需要复现的动作，而是将其作为关于约束的证据：一个纠正模型（Correction Model）预测人类会如何纠正给定的VLA提案，以及该纠正在每个动作维度上的一致性程度。这一预测一致性为策略优化中每个维度的约束紧度设定了标准。在纠正一致的维度上，策略保持接近人类行为；在纠正多变的维度上，约束则相应放松。我们在三个真实世界操作任务和一个LIBERO-Pro仿真任务上，以匹配的在线数据预算对BEE进行了评估。BEE在所有任务上均取得了最高成功率，平均达到91.2%，而RLT为57.5%，DSRL为42.1%；同时，在所有真实世界任务中，BEE的人工干预率也最低。

title: Omnidirectional Amphibious Locomotion via Internal Mass Actuation
summary: Field robots must traverse varied terrain and obstacles while remaining robust to water, debris, vegetation, and physical contact. We present MARBLE, a fully enclosed omnidirectional amphibious rolling robot driven entirely by internal mass redistribution. Three mutually orthogonal linear sliders shift internal masses to generate body rotation, while an orientation-aware controller maps planar velocity commands into slider positions. A rigid spherical shell encloses all active mechanisms and simultaneously serves as the terrestrial contact surface, buoyant enclosure, and mounting structure for passive fins that enable water-surface propulsion. Rotation of the same shell architecture hence produces rolling on land and surface propulsion in water without mechanical reconfiguration or separate locomotion actuators. The spherical morphology further allows the robot to accommodate changes in body orientation and contact location during direct interactions with terrain and obstacles. We evaluate MARBLE through omnidirectional locomotion characterization, traversal across heterogeneous terrestrial environments, aquatic surface locomotion, land-water transitions, and deliberate obstacle interactions. These experiments demonstrate how a single enclosed mechanical architecture can combine omnidirectional mobility, cross-medium locomotion, and tolerance to environmental contact. MARBLE provides a compact design for field mobility across heterogeneous terrain, obstacles, and land-water transitions. We will open-source all software and hardware design. Our website is https://generalroboticslab.com/MARBLE
tldr: MARBLE is a fully enclosed, omnidirectional amphibious rolling robot that uses internal mass redistribution for locomotion on land and water, demonstrating cross-medium mobility without mechanical reconfiguration.
tldr_zh: MARBLE 是一种完全封闭的、全方位水陆两栖滚动机器人，通过内部质量重新分配实现陆地和水中运动，无需机械重构即可跨介质移动。
summary_zh: 野外机器人必须能够穿越各种地形和障碍物，同时保持对水、碎屑、植被及物理接触的耐受性。我们提出了MARBLE——一种完全封闭的全向两栖滚动机器人，完全依靠内部质量重新分布来驱动。三个相互正交的线性滑块通过移动内部质量来产生机体旋转，同时一个姿态感知控制器将平面速度指令映射为滑块位置。一个刚性球壳封闭了所有主动机构，并同时作为陆地接触表面、浮力外壳以及被动鳍片的安装结构，从而实现水面推进。因此，同一球壳结构的旋转可以在陆地上滚动，在水中实现水面推进，而无需机械重构或额外的运动执行器。球形形态还使机器人能够在地形和障碍物的直接交互中适应机体姿态和接触位置的变化。我们通过全向运动特性表征、跨异构陆地环境的穿越、水面运动、水陆过渡以及有意的障碍物交互来评估MARBLE的性能。这些实验展示了一种单一的封闭机械架构如何将全向移动性、跨介质运动和对外部环境接触的耐受性结合起来。MARBLE为跨越异构地形、障碍物以及水陆过渡的野外移动提供了一种紧凑的设计方案。我们将开源所有软件和硬件设计。我们的网站是：https://generalroboticslab.com/MARBLE

title: CoRe-WAM: Correspondence-Aligned Temporal Residuals for World Action Models
summary: Comparing current and past observations helps robots understand scene changes and select subsequent actions during manipulation. However, comparing visual features at the same image location can mix different scene content when objects or the camera move. We introduce CoRe-WAM, a world-action model that incorporates correspondence-aligned visual changes through a parameter-efficient temporal interface. Its TraceDelta module uses correspondences from a frozen tracking model to transport historical visual features to current locations before computing signed differences in a shared pretrained feature space. Correspondence thus determines which historical content is compared with the present, rather than entering the policy as a separate trajectory representation. A lightweight adapter converts these differences into validity-gated residuals that supplement current visual conditioning, allowing the policy to use recent changes alongside current-scene information. Built on Motus, CoRe-WAM keeps the pretrained backbone weights frozen and optimizes 1.59 million parameters. With a 5,000-update adaptation budget, CoRe-WAM achieves 92.22% clean success across 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, 3.56 percentage points above Motus; on randomized evaluation, it achieves 89.60% success, a 2.58-point gain. Integrating TraceDelta into a StarVLA-based policy improves clean success from 58.10% to 67.62%, supporting transfer of the temporal interface beyond Motus.
tldr: CoRe-WAM introduces a correspondence-aligned temporal residual module (TraceDelta) for world action models, enabling efficient use of historical visual features for robotic manipulation without updating pretrained backbones.
tldr_zh: CoRe-WAM 提出了一个对应关系对齐的时序残差模块 (TraceDelta)，用于世界动作模型，在不更新预训练主干网络的情况下高效利用历史视觉信息进行机器人操作。
summary_zh: 比较当前与过去的观测有助于机器人在操作过程中理解场景变化并选择后续动作。然而，当物体或相机发生移动时，在相同图像位置比较视觉特征可能会混淆不同的场景内容。我们提出了CoRe-WAM，一种世界-动作模型，通过参数高效的时间接口整合了对应关系对齐的视觉变化。其TraceDelta模块利用冻结跟踪模型中的对应关系，先将历史视觉特征迁移到当前位置，再在共享的预训练特征空间中计算带符号的差异。因此，对应关系决定了哪些历史内容与当前内容进行比较，而非作为独立的轨迹表示输入到策略中。一个轻量级适配器将这些差异转换为有效性门控残差，用以补充当前的视觉条件，使策略能够同时利用近期变化与当前场景信息。基于Motus构建的CoRe-WAM保持预训练骨干网络权重冻结，仅优化159万个参数。在5，000次更新的适应预算下，CoRe-WAM在50个RoboTwin 2.0任务上实现了92.22%的干净成功率，比Motus高出3.56个百分点；在随机化评估中，其成功率达到89.60%，提升了2.58个百分点。将TraceDelta集成到基于StarVLA的策略中，干净成功率从58.10%提高到67.62%，验证了该时间接口在Motus之外的可迁移性。

title: CereVLA: Cerebellum-Inspired Consequence-Aware Residual Governance for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Execution
summary: Action-chunked vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve inference efficiency, but limited feedback within committed action chunks can lead to accumulated execution errors. Residual adaptation can correct such deviations without retraining the VLA; however, existing corrections are typically optimized for reference-action consistency without explicitly considering their downstream consequences. To address this limitation, we present Cerebellum-Inspired Consequence-Aware Residual Governance (CereVLA), a unified framework that integrates lightweight residual refinement and predictive consequence evaluation into frozen VLA execution. Corrective actions are first generated by flow-based residual refinement, and their short- and interval-horizon consequences are then evaluated by a recurrent state-space model and a history-aware classifier. Residual corrections predicted to be unfavorable are selectively suppressed by a lightweight governor. Comparisons with state-of-the-art methods on LIBERO-10 and LIBERO-GOAL demonstrate the effectiveness of CereVLA. On SO-101, CereVLA increases task success from 57.5% to 90.0% and reduces mean control steps by 19.6% among successful trials, relative to the frozen SmolVLA baseline.
tldr: CereVLA introduces a cerebellum-inspired residual governance framework that refines and evaluates corrective actions during VLA execution, improving task success and efficiency on manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: CereVLA 提出了一种受小脑启发的后果感知残差治理框架，在 VLA 执行过程中对纠正动作进行细化和评估，从而提升操作基准上的任务成功率和效率。
summary_zh: 动作分块的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提高了推理效率，但既定动作分块内的有限反馈可能导致累积执行误差。残差自适应可以纠正此类偏差而无需重新训练VLA；然而，现有的纠偏方法通常以参考动作一致性为优化目标，未能显式考虑其下游后果。为克服这一局限，我们提出了类小脑启发的后果感知残差调控框架（CereVLA），该统一框架将轻量级残差精修与预测性后果评估集成到冻结的VLA执行过程中。首先通过基于流的残差精修生成纠偏动作，随后由循环状态空间模型和历史感知分类器评估这些动作的短期及区间跨度后果。预测为不利的残差校正将由轻量级调控器选择性地抑制。在LIBERO-10和LIBERO-GOAL上与最先进方法的对比实验验证了CereVLA的有效性。在SO-101上，相较于冻结的SmolVLA基线，CereVLA将任务成功率从57.5%提升至90.0%，并在成功试验中平均控制步数降低19.6%。

title: LiMA: Bridging Long-term Imagination to Real-time Dexterous Manipulation via Asynchronous Diffusion
summary: Dexterous manipulation demands long-term foresight and rapid reactive control. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, while proficient in high-level reasoning, often lack a fine-grained understanding of physical dynamics and spatial perception. Conversely, World-Action Models (WAMs) typically suffer from high inference latency due to iterative generation. These deficiencies result in a critical temporal misalignment where the model's intent fails to adapt to rapid physical contact changes. To overcome this fundamental bottleneck, we propose LiMA, an asynchronous dual-system generative framework that systematically decouples intent planning from reactive execution. LiMA organizes computation into a multi-scale hierarchy: a slow system handles sparse long-horizon spatiotemporal intent generation, while a fast system focuses on dense high-frequency motion refinement. To align sparse intent predictions with dense action trajectories, we introduce a Latent Schrödinger Bridge Coupling mechanism that formulates refinement as an entropy-regularized probabilistic transport process. LiMA reduces inference latency by 45.8% compared with Cosmos-Policy via asynchronous decoupling. Evaluated across six bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks spanning multiple horizons, LiMA achieves an overall success rate of 70.8% and an average subtask success rate of 78.9%, while maintaining performance in unseen scenarios. The project website is available at https://ccdcs.github.io/LiMA_repo/
tldr: LiMA introduces an asynchronous dual-system generative framework that decouples long-horizon intent planning from real-time reactive execution for dexterous manipulation, using a Latent Schrödinger Bridge Coupling to align sparse intents with dense actions, reducing inference latency and improving success rates.
tldr_zh: LiMA提出了一种异步双系统生成框架，将灵巧操作中的长期意图规划与实时反应执行解耦，并利用潜在薛定谔桥耦合对齐稀疏意图与密集动作，从而降低推理延迟并提高成功率。
summary_zh: 灵巧操作既需要长期的前瞻性规划，也需要快速的反应式控制。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽然擅长高层推理，但往往缺乏对物理动力学和空间感知的细粒度理解。相比之下，世界-动作模型（WAMs）通常因迭代生成而产生较高的推理延迟。这些缺陷导致了关键的时间错位问题，即模型的意图无法适应快速的物理接触变化。为突破这一根本性瓶颈，我们提出了LiMA，一种异步双系统生成式框架，系统性地将意图规划与反应式执行解耦。LiMA将计算组织为多尺度层次结构：慢速系统负责稀疏的长时程时空意图生成，而快速系统专注于密集的高频动作细化。为使稀疏的意图预测与密集的动作轨迹对齐，我们引入了潜在薛定谔桥耦合机制，将细化过程建模为熵正则化的概率输运过程。与Cosmos-Policy相比，LiMA通过异步解耦将推理延迟降低了45.8%。在涵盖多种时间跨度的六项双臂灵巧操作任务评估中，LiMA实现了70.8%的总体成功率和78.9%的平均子任务成功率，同时在未见场景中保持了稳定性能。项目网站见https://ccdcs.github.io/LiMA_repo/

title: Watch, Recall, Act: Always-On Robots in Concurrent Embodied Streams
summary: An always-on robot faces an endless stream that never resets: instructions arrive and lapse, the scene changes, and its own past actions reshape what it must reason about. Today's action models are built for the opposite: a fixed instruction, no mid-task intervention, single-step reasoning. In an open-ended world a robot must watch a live stream for far-future cues, recall its own far-past actions, and act on them under dual-arm concurrency. We present ARMS (Always-on Robot in Multi-modal Streams), a deliberately simple streaming policy: a single pretrained $π$0.5 backbone augmented by three lightweight modules that turn live perception, embodied states, and the robot's own past actions into context the backbone reads before it acts. The modules update this context asynchronously, so watching and recalling never block acting and the two arms act at once. Rather than inventing new mechanisms, ARMS integrates these learned context providers with an agent-causal self-history that logs which arm did what, and when. To supervise them without extra annotation, we build ARMS Dataset, whose staged construction script itself labels every module from real dual-arm teleoperation. Trained on it, ARMS reaches 45% on the combined task against 28% for the strongest of our four main baselines, and ablations confirm the memory module, the embodied-state head, and asynchronous concurrency are each necessary.
tldr: This paper introduces ARMS, a streaming policy for always-on robots that integrates memory, embodied state, and asynchronous dual-arm concurrency into a pretrained VLA backbone, achieving significant improvements over baselines on a real dual-arm teleoperation dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 ARMS，一种面向常开机器人的流式策略，将记忆、具身状态和异步双臂并发整合到预训练 VLA 骨干中，在真实双臂遥操作数据上取得了显著优于基线的性能。
summary_zh: 一个持续运行的机器人面对着永不停歇、永不重置的信息流：指令不断到来又过期，场景持续变化，它过往的行为又反过来重塑了它必须推理的内容。如今的动作模型却是为相反的情形设计的：固定指令、无中途干预、单步推理。在开放式的世界中，机器人必须实时观察信息流以捕捉远期线索，回忆自身久远的动作，并在双臂并行的条件下据此采取行动。我们提出ARMS（Always-on Robot in Multi-modal Streams，多模态流中的持续运行机器人），这是一种刻意简化的流式策略：以单一预训练的π⁰.⁵骨干网络为基础，附加三个轻量模块，将实时感知、具身状态以及机器人自身的过往动作转化为骨干网络在执行动作前所读取的上下文。这些模块异步更新上下文，因此观察与回忆不会阻塞执行，双臂也能同时运作。ARMS并非发明新机制，而是将这些学习得到的上下文提供器与一种智能体因果性自历史记录相整合，该记录保存了哪只手臂在何时做了什么。为在无需额外标注的情况下监督这些模块，我们构建了ARMS数据集，其分阶段构建脚本本身就为每个模块从真实双臂遥操作中提供标注。在该数据集上训练后，ARMS在组合任务上达到45%的成功率，而四个主要基线中最强者为28%；消融实验进一步证实，记忆模块、具身状态头以及异步并发机制各自都是不可或缺的。

title: Privacy-Preserving Semantic Segmentation from High-Resolution Depth and Ultra-Low-Resolution RGB
summary: As mobile robots become increasingly integrated into everyday environments, privacy risks arising from onboard cameras have become a growing concern. Ultra-low-resolution (ULR) RGB can mitigate visual privacy exposure at the source, but ULR appearance alone substantially limits semantic and spatial understanding. We therefore introduce a privacy-preserving asymmetric sensing setting that combines high-resolution (HR) depth with ULR RGB, preserving dense geometry while restricting fine-grained visual information. To address the severe information imbalance between HR depth and ULR RGB, we propose a joint 2D framework using HR geometry to guide semantic-oriented RGB reconstruction and RGB-D segmentation. Despite reliable frame-level predictions, consistent scene-level understanding remains challenging under the asymmetric HR depth--ULR RGB setting. We therefore develop an end-to-end 2D-to-3D pipeline that consolidates 2D semantic features for 3D segmentation. Experiments on ScanNet show that our method achieves the best 2D and 3D segmentation performance among privacy-preserving approaches and delivers the strongest zero-shot transfer to SUN RGB-D and SceneNN. Privacy recoverability analysis shows that our proposed HR depth--ULR RGB input reduces the recoverability of sensitive data, and real-robot experiments demonstrate the utility of the resulting 3D semantics for object-goal navigation.
tldr: This paper introduces a privacy-preserving sensing setup combining high-resolution depth with ultra-low-resolution RGB for semantic segmentation, proposing a 2D-to-3D pipeline that achieves state-of-the-art performance among privacy-preserving methods and demonstrates real-robot utility for object-goal navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种结合高分辨率深度和超低分辨率RGB的隐私保护传感设置，用于语义分割，通过2D到3D的流程在隐私保护方法中达到最优性能，并展示了在真实机器人上进行目标导航的实用性。
summary_zh: 随着移动机器人在日常环境中的日益普及，车载摄像头引发的隐私风险已成为一个日益受到关注的问题。超低分辨率（ULR）RGB图像能够在源头降低视觉隐私暴露，但仅依赖超低分辨率外观会大幅限制语义与空间理解能力。为此，我们提出了一种隐私保护的非对称感知设置，将高分辨率（HR）深度与超低分辨率RGB相结合，在保留密集几何信息的同时限制细粒度视觉信息。为解决高分辨率深度与超低分辨率RGB之间严重的信息失衡问题，我们提出了一种联合2D框架，利用高分辨率几何信息引导面向语义的RGB重建及RGB-D分割。尽管帧级预测结果可靠，但在高分辨率深度—超低分辨率RGB的非对称设置下，实现一致的场景级理解仍具挑战性。因此，我们开发了一条端到端的2D至3D处理流程，将2D语义特征整合为3D分割结果。在ScanNet上的实验表明，我们的方法在隐私保护方法中取得了最优的2D和3D分割性能，并对SUN RGB-D和SceneNN展现出最强的零样本迁移能力。隐私可恢复性分析显示，我们所提出的高分辨率深度—超低分辨率RGB输入降低了敏感数据的可恢复性，真实机器人实验则证明了所生成的3D语义在物体目标导航中的实用性。

title: TANDEM: Task and Motion Planning with As-Needed Demonstrations for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Fine-tuning
summary: Human teleoperators spend substantial time demonstrating behaviors that robots can already perform autonomously, limiting the scalability of data collection for robot foundation models. Task and motion planning (TAMP) can automate many of these behaviors, but a fixed planning domain may not support every stage of a long-horizon manipulation task. We present TANDEM (Tamp with As-Needed Demonstrations for Efficient Model fine-tuning), a system that combines TAMP with selective human teleoperation to collect demonstrations for tasks beyond the planner's capabilities. Our key idea is to represent human assistance as an on-demand planning capability. Given a language instruction and visual observation, TANDEM uses pretrained vision-language models to extend the planning domain with missing predicates and human-executed magic operators. This allows the planner to interleave autonomous and human-executed stages without task-specific intervention points. After each human stage, TANDEM re-perceives the scene and checks whether the intended effects hold before resuming autonomous planning. To support fine-tuning vision-language-action (VLA) models, TANDEM also uses example pretraining trajectories to align planner-generated motions with the target model's pretraining distribution. We evaluate TANDEM on five long-horizon manipulation tasks beyond the TAMP domain's capabilities. On a representative long-horizon task, TANDEM collects 2.9x as many demonstrations as full-task teleoperation at the same human intervention time. Fine-tuning a pretrained π_{0.5}-DROID model on 20 TANDEM demonstrations per task increases average task success from 0% to 60% across the five tasks.
tldr: TANDEM combines task and motion planning with on-demand human teleoperation to efficiently collect diverse demonstrations for fine-tuning vision-language-action models, improving task success from 0% to 60% on long-horizon manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: TANDEM将任务与运动规划与按需人工遥操作相结合，高效收集用于微调视觉-语言-动作模型的多样化演示，在长时程操作任务中将任务成功率从0%提升到60%。
summary_zh: 人类遥操作员花费大量时间演示机器人已能自主完成的行为，这限制了机器人基础模型数据收集的可扩展性。任务与运动规划（TAMP）可以自动化许多此类行为，但固定的规划域可能无法支持长时程操作任务的每个阶段。我们提出TANDEM（按需演示的TAMP高效模型微调系统），该系统将TAMP与选择性人工遥操作相结合，为超出规划器能力范围的任务收集演示数据。我们的关键思想是将人工辅助表示为一种按需规划能力。给定语言指令和视觉观察，TANDEM利用预训练的视觉-语言模型，通过缺失谓词和人类执行的魔法算子扩展规划域。这使得规划器能够自主执行与人工执行阶段交错进行，无需特定于任务的干预点。在每个人工阶段之后，TANDEM重新感知场景，并在恢复自主规划之前检查预期效果是否成立。为支持视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的微调，TANDEM还使用示例预训练轨迹，将规划器生成的运动与目标模型的预训练分布对齐。我们在五个超出TAMP规划域能力的长时程操作任务上评估TANDEM。在一个代表性长时程任务中，在相同人工干预时间下，TANDEM收集的演示数量是全任务遥操作的2.9倍。在每任务20个TANDEM演示上微调预训练π_{0.5}-DROID模型，五个任务的平均任务成功率从0%提升至60%。

title: Talk2Escape: Conversational Grounding for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary:
While Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has demonstrated remarkable success, the prevailing single-turn paradigm exposes a fundamental vulnerability: agents operate in a strictly open-loop manner. In practice, factors such as perceptual aliasing, sensor noise, and odometry drift can cause minor deviations to accumulate over time, often leading to catastrophic mission failures with no built-in mechanism for error recovery. To address this, we introduce \textit{Talk2Escape}, a proactive and model-agnostic dialogue intervention framework that reframes navigation as a closed-loop interactive process. At its core, a lightweight vision-language module continuously monitors agent kinematics. Upon detecting localized looping or severe trajectory divergence, it translates raw egocentric observations into concise, grounded queries to solicit targeted corrective feedback from either an algorithmic oracle or a human-in-the-loop. Extensive evaluations in high-fidelity simulators, including R2R-CE, RxR-CE, and VLNVerse,
  demonstrate that \textit{Talk2Escape} exhibits consistent improvements across diverse base agents. Empirically, \textit{Talk2Escape} achieves a 66.0\% Success Rate on R2R-CE, outperforming the current supervised and zero-shot state-of-the-art methods. We further validate its sim-to-real transfer on a Unitree Go2 quadruped, proving that proactive dialogue drastically improves navigation robustness in physical environments.
tldr: Talk2Escape introduces a proactive dialogue intervention framework that converts vision-and-language navigation from an open-loop to a closed-loop process, enabling error recovery via targeted queries to an oracle or human, and demonstrating robust performance gains in simulators and on a real quadruped robot.
tldr_zh: Talk2Escape 提出了一个主动对话干预框架，将视觉语言导航从开环转变为闭环过程，通过与算法或人类交互获取针对性反馈来恢复错误，在仿真和真实四足机器人上均验证了显著鲁棒性提升。
summary_zh: 尽管视觉与语言导航（VLN）已展现出显著的成功，但当前主流的单轮交互范式暴露出一个根本性缺陷：智能体以严格的开环方式运行。在实际应用中，感知混淆、传感器噪声和里程计漂移等因素可能导致微小偏差随时间累积，往往因缺乏内置的错误恢复机制而引发灾难性的任务失败。为解决这一问题，我们提出\textit{Talk2Escape}——一种主动且与模型无关的对话干预框架，将导航重新构建为闭环交互过程。其核心是一个轻量级视觉-语言模块，持续监控智能体的运动学状态。一旦检测到局部循环或严重轨迹偏离，该模块会将原始自我中心观察转化为简洁、有依据的查询，以向算法预言机或人工介入者征求有针对性的纠正反馈。在高保真模拟器（包括R2R-CE、RxR-CE和VLNVerse）中的广泛评估表明，\textit{Talk2Escape}在多种基础智能体上均展现出一致的性能提升。实验数据显示，\textit{Talk2Escape}在R2R-CE上实现了66.0\%的成功率，超越了当前有监督和零样本的最先进方法。我们进一步在宇树Go2四足机器人上验证了其仿真到现实迁移能力，证明了主动对话能够显著提升物理环境中的导航鲁棒性。

title: BrickCraft-Duo: Efficient Dual-Arm Skill Learning and Refinement for Compositional Long-Horizon Assembly
summary: Interlocking brick assembly provides a representative testbed for evaluating real-world robotic manipulation capabilities, where diverse structural designs, complex inter-step dependencies, intricate mechanical interactions and tight insertion tolerances pose substantial challenges. We present BrickCraft-Duo, a modular framework for long-horizon dual-arm collaborative assembly of interlocking bricks through data-efficient skill learning and composition. BrickCraft-Duo learns reusable single- and dual-arm assembly skills from diverse demonstrations, with bilateral symmetry alignment facilitating skill sharing across symmetric arms and assembly--support role assignments. Guided by stability-aware assembly reasoning, BrickCraft-Duo composes heterogeneous skills to achieve autonomous long-horizon execution, and further integrates human-in-the-loop correction for targeted skill refinement. The resulting system achieves long-horizon success rates of at least 60% and step-level completion rates of at least 95% across five real-world assembly tasks involving partially supported configurations, with horizons of up to nine steps. Project website: https://jichuan-yu.github.io/BrickCraft-Duo.
tldr: BrickCraft-Duo presents a modular framework for data-efficient dual-arm robotic assembly of interlocking bricks, leveraging reusable skill learning, symmetry-aware skill sharing, stability-aware task planning, and human-in-the-loop refinement to achieve long-horizon success on real-world assembly tasks.
tldr_zh: BrickCraft-Duo 提出了一种模块化框架，用于数据高效的双臂机器人互锁积木组装，通过可复用技能学习、对称性技能共享、稳定性感知任务规划以及人在回路细化，在真实世界长时程装配任务中取得了成功。
summary_zh: 互锁积木装配为评估真实世界机器人操作能力提供了一个代表性测试平台，其中多样化的结构设计、复杂的步骤间依赖关系、精细的机械相互作用以及紧凑的插入公差构成了巨大挑战。我们提出了BrickCraft-Duo，一个模块化框架，通过数据高效的技能学习和组合，实现互锁积木的长时程双臂协作装配。BrickCraft-Duo从多样化的演示中学习可复用的单臂和双臂装配技能，并通过双侧对称对齐促进对称手臂之间以及装配-支撑角色分配之间的技能共享。在稳定性感知的装配推理引导下，BrickCraft-Duo组合异构技能以实现自主的长时程执行，并进一步集成人在回路的修正机制，用于针对性的技能优化。所构建的系统在五个涉及部分支撑配置的真实世界装配任务中，实现了至少60%的长时程成功率和至少95%的步骤级完成率，任务时程最长可达九个步骤。项目网站：https://jichuan-yu.github.io/BrickCraft-Duo。

title: Generalizable Robotic Insertion with World Models
summary: Robotic assembly in high-mixture settings requires adaptable systems that can handle diverse parts, yet current approaches typically rely on policies specialized to each insertion task. Although this can reach high success rates, it makes the process of deploying systems for new problems tedious and time consuming. We present a framework for generalizable insertion using world models that combine robot proprioceptive information with raw visual observations captured by a wrist-mounted camera. Our model-based approach trains a single world model on up to 90 insertion tasks with geometrically diverse parts, achieving 56% zero-shot success on unseen objects with unknown geometry compared to just 7% with a model-free baseline. Importantly, performance improves as more objects are included in the training dataset, demonstrating strong scalability. Lastly, finetuning the generalist model on held-out objects significantly enhances data-efficiency compared to training from scratch and, in some cases, achieves better asymptotic performance. To our knowledge, this is the first system capable of assembling unseen objects in an entirely data-driven manner, and thus represents a significant step toward scalable, generalizable robotic assembly systems.
tldr: This paper proposes a world model-based framework for generalizable robotic insertion that trains a single model on 90 insertion tasks and achieves zero-shot success on unseen objects, outperforming a model-free baseline and showing scalability and data-efficiency benefits.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于世界模型的通用机器人插入框架，在90个插入任务上训练单一模型，实现对未见物体的零样本成功，优于无模型基线，并展示了可扩展性和数据效率优势。
summary_zh: 机器人装配在高混合场景中需要能够处理多种零部件的自适应系统，然而现有方法通常依赖于针对每个插入任务专门化的策略。尽管这种方法能够达到较高的成功率，但部署系统以应对新问题的过程却繁琐且耗时。我们提出了一种基于世界模型的通用化插入框架，该模型将机器人本体感知信息与腕部相机捕获的原始视觉观察相结合。我们的基于模型的方法在多达90个具有几何多样性零部件的插入任务上训练单一世界模型，在未知几何形状的全新物体上实现了56%的零样本成功率，而基于无模型的基线方法仅为7%。重要的是，随着训练数据集中包含更多物体，性能持续提升，展现出强大的可扩展性。最后，在保留物体上对通用模型进行微调，相较于从头训练显著提高了数据效率，并且在某些情况下达到了更好的渐进性能。据我们所知，这是首个能够以完全数据驱动方式装配未见物体的系统，因此代表了向可扩展、可泛化的机器人装配系统迈出的重要一步。

title: DAVIS: A Depth-Only End-to-End Active-Vision Framework for Humanoid Soccer Skills
summary: Humanoid soccer contact skills require more than producing high-impact foot-ball contacts: the robot must close the loop over perception, approach, alignment, impact, and recovery while its own motion induces substantial viewpoint changes, frequent loss of the ball from view, and uncertain contact outcomes. In this work, we ask a compact yet stricter question: can a humanoid learn soccer contact skills using only a head-mounted depth image, proprioceptive history, and an optional low-dimensional task command, and directly output 25-DoF joint PD targets without extra runtime perception or planning modules? To this end, we propose DAVIS, a depth-only end-to-end framework for humanoid soccer skills that learns visibility-aware auxiliary geometry during training, and combines GT-to-prediction annealing, task curricula, and AMP-style motion priors to smoothly bridge privileged supervision and real deployment. Built on this framework, we instantiate representative soccer contact skills, including goal-directed shooting and directional dribbling, through task-specific definitions of objects, commands, rewards, and curricula, and validate them through simulation, Noetix E1 real-robot experiments, and ablations.
tldr: DAVIS is a depth-only end-to-end framework for humanoid soccer skills, using head-mounted depth images and proprioception to directly output joint targets, validated in simulation and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: DAVIS 是一个仅使用深度图的端到端框架，用于人形机器人足球技能，通过头部深度图像和本体感觉直接输出关节目标，并在仿真和真实机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 类人机器人足球接触技能不仅要求产生高冲击力的脚-球接触：机器人还必须在感知、逼近、对准、撞击和恢复之间闭环，而其自身运动会引起视点的显著变化、球的频繁丢失以及接触结果的不确定性。在本研究中，我们提出了一个紧凑但更严格的问题：类人机器人能否仅依靠头部安装的深度图像、本体感受历史以及可选的低维任务指令，直接输出25自由度关节PD目标，而无需额外的运行时感知或规划模块？为此，我们提出了DAVIS，一种仅基于深度图像的端到端类人足球技能框架，该框架在训练过程中学习可见性感知的辅助几何信息，并结合真实值到预测的退火策略、任务课程以及AMP风格的运动先验，以实现特权监督与实际部署之间的平滑过渡。在该框架基础上，我们通过任务特定的对象、指令、奖励和课程定义，实例化了代表性的足球接触技能，包括目标导向射门和定向运球，并通过仿真、Noetix E1真实机器人实验以及消融研究进行了验证。

title: InfiNoVA: Infinite Novel View Augmentation for Viewpoint Invariant Robot Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often rely strongly on the camera viewpoints seen during training, causing substantial performance degradation when deployed from unseen perspectives. Collecting demonstrations from sufficiently diverse physical viewpoints is expensive and still provides only sparse coverage of the viewpoint space. We introduce InfiNoVA, a data-augmentation framework that converts synchronized multi-camera demonstrations into a dense distribution of geometrically consistent training views. InfiNoVA reconstructs each manipulation trajectory as a time-varying 3D Gaussian representation and renders novel observations from sampled camera poses while preserving the original state-action correspondence. This explicit scene representation improves frame-level fidelity and temporal consistency while reducing task-critical hallucinations observed in generative novel-view synthesis. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, policies trained with InfiNoVA achieve 5.4x higher average success under unseen randomized viewpoints than both VISTA-based augmentation and the unaugmented policy. InfiNoVA further achieves 1.7x higher success than training directly on all five physical camera views. These results show that dense, geometrically grounded viewpoint augmentation provides a practical route toward camera-robust robot policies without modifying the underlying policy architecture.
tldr: InfiNoVA is a data augmentation framework that reconstructs manipulation trajectories as 3D Gaussians and renders novel training views, substantially improving viewpoint robustness of VLA policies on real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: InfiNoVA 是一种数据增强框架，通过将操作轨迹重建为 3D 高斯并渲染新视角，显著提高了 VLA 策略在真实世界任务中的视角鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略往往严重依赖训练时所见的相机视角，导致在从未见过的视角下部署时性能大幅下降。从多种物理视角采集示范数据成本高昂，且对视角空间的覆盖仍然稀疏。我们提出InfiNoVA，一种数据增强框架，可将同步多相机示范转换为几何一致的高密度训练视角分布。InfiNoVA将每条操作轨迹重建为随时间变化的3D高斯表示，并在保持原始状态-动作对应关系的同时，从采样相机位姿渲染新视角观测。这种显式场景表示提升了帧级保真度和时间一致性，同时减少了生成式新视角合成中出现的任务关键性幻觉。在四个真实世界操作任务中，使用InfiNoVA训练的策略在未见随机视角下的平均成功率比基于VISTA的增强方法和无增强策略高出5.4倍。此外，InfiNoVA比直接在全部五个物理相机视角上训练的成功率高出1.7倍。这些结果表明，密集且具有几何基础的视角增强为在不修改底层策略架构的前提下实现相机鲁棒的机器人策略提供了可行路径。

title: GLoTouch: Global-to-Local Haptic Perception Using a Parallel Gripper for Object Search, Recognition, and Grasping Without External Vision
summary: Perceiving objects in the environment is a fundamental capability of autonomous robots. In dark or low-light environments, external cameras often fail to reliably perceive object positions and geometry; when visual sensing is unavailable, completing target search, recognition, and grasping through touch alone becomes a key robot manipulation capability. This task must simultaneously address container-scale spatial exploration and object-scale fine-grained geometric perception, which is particularly challenging for low-degree-of-freedom parallel grippers. However, a unified framework remains lacking for connecting container-scale spatial exploration with object-scale fine-grained geometric perception and grasping. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{GLoTouch}, a global-to-local haptic perception and manipulation framework built on a parallel gripper. In the global stage, the gripper holds a passive long-reach probe, combining force measurements with known tool geometry to localize contacts and actively estimate candidate-object positions, coarse contours, and heights. In the local stage, the robot sets down the probe and uses the bilateral visuotactile sensors on the same gripper to directly acquire local haptic observations, which are matched against a given target 3-D model without object-specific training. We evaluate the framework in both simulation and real-robot experiments. Source code will be open-sourced.
tldr: GLoTouch presents a global-to-local haptic perception framework for parallel grippers, enabling object search, recognition, and grasping in dark environments without external vision, tested in simulation and on real robots.
tldr_zh: GLoTouch 提出了一种面向平行夹爪的由全局到局部的触觉感知框架，可在无外部视觉的黑暗环境中实现物体搜索、识别与抓取，并在仿真和真实机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 感知环境中的物体是自主机器人的一项基本能力。在黑暗或低光照环境下，外部相机往往无法可靠地感知物体的位置和几何形状；当视觉感知不可用时，仅通过触觉完成目标搜索、识别和抓取，便成为机器人一项关键的操作能力。该任务需同时应对容器尺度的空间探索与物体尺度的精细几何感知，这对低自由度平行夹爪而言尤为困难。然而，目前仍缺乏一个统一框架，将容器尺度的空间探索与物体尺度的精细几何感知及抓取联系起来。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了\textbf{GLoTouch}，一种基于平行夹爪的从全局到局部的触觉感知与操作框架。在全局阶段，夹爪持有一根被动式长探针，结合力测量与已知工具几何形状，定位接触点，并主动估计候选物体的位置、粗略轮廓及高度。在局部阶段，机器人放下探针，利用同一夹爪上的双侧视触觉传感器直接获取局部触觉观测，并将其与给定的目标三维模型进行匹配，无需针对特定物体进行训练。我们在仿真与真实机器人实验中对该框架进行了评估。源代码将开源。

title: InternW0: A Foundational Physical World Model for Efficient Real-World Interactions
summary: Physical intelligence requires more than predicting how the world may evolve: predictions must remain actionable as the world continues to change. We introduce InternW0, the first instantiation of the InternW physical world model series from Shanghai AI Laboratory, built around omnimodal interfaces, asynchronous multi-frequency processing, and local physical modeling under partial observations and external influences. InternW0 jointly learns future visual dynamics and continuous robot control through an asymmetric video--action architecture with flow matching. A high-capacity video expert provides longer-horizon predictive context, while a lightweight action expert operates at a faster timescale. Instead of regenerating the future for every action update, InternW0 reuses layerwise K/V and adapts it to newly observed states through observation-conditioned context routing. Domain-specific interfaces and soft prompts support heterogeneous embodiments, while contact-aware post-training incorporates force and tactile signals for contact-rich manipulation. We train InternW0 on approximately 7,200 hours of heterogeneous robot and egocentric data, including EgoLab, a 275-hour real-laboratory egocentric dataset. Evaluation spans simulation benchmarks and real-world scientific tasks, including a 15-stage metal--organic framework synthesis workflow and 5-stage contact- and force-aware dexterous manipulation for general-purpose quantitative pipetting. These results advance scalable, asynchronous, and science-native physical world models for universal and efficient real-world interactions.
tldr: InternW0 is a foundational physical world model that jointly learns visual dynamics and robot control via an asymmetric video-action architecture with flow matching, trained on heterogeneous robot and egocentric data, and demonstrated on simulation benchmarks and real-world scientific tasks.
tldr_zh: InternW0 是一个基础物理世界模型，通过非对称视频-动作架构和流匹配联合学习视觉动态与机器人控制，在异构机器人和自我中心数据上训练，并在仿真基准和真实科学任务中验证。
summary_zh: 物理智能不仅要求预测世界的演变方式，更要求在环境持续变化时预测结果仍具可操作性。我们推出InternW0，这是上海人工智能实验室InternW物理世界模型系列的首个实现，其核心构建于全模态接口、异步多频处理，以及在部分观测与外部影响下的局部物理建模。InternW0通过非对称的“视频-动作”架构结合流匹配技术，联合学习未来视觉动态与连续机器人控制。高容量视频专家提供更长时域的预测上下文，而轻量级动作专家则以更快的时标运行。InternW0并非针对每次动作更新重新生成未来帧，而是复用逐层的K/V（键/值）信息，并通过观测条件上下文路由，将其适配至新观测到的状态。领域专用接口与软提示支持异构本体，而接触感知的后训练阶段则引入力与触觉信号，以支持富含接触的操作任务。我们在约7,200小时的异构机器人与自我中心数据上训练InternW0，其中包括EgoLab这一275小时的真实实验室自我中心数据集。评估涵盖仿真基准与真实世界科学任务，包括15阶段的金属有机框架合成流程，以及面向通用定量移液的5阶段接触与力感知灵巧操作。这些成果推动了可扩展、异步且面向科学本位的物理世界模型的发展，为通用且高效的真实世界交互奠定基础。

title: NavProbe: Evidence-Grounded Reasoning with Active Memory Retrieval for Zero-Shot Navigation
summary: Long-horizon navigation requires an agent to revise its intermediate objectives as evidence accumulates. Full visual histories are costly to process, while compact summaries may omit details needed to reconsider earlier decisions. We introduce NavProbe, a hierarchical zero-shot navigation agent that couples a dynamic subgoal agenda with active evidence retrieval. A compact index links summaries of visited places, transitions, and landmarks to their visual and geometric records. When the current context is insufficient, a task executive retrieves targeted evidence to generate, revise, or resolve subgoals. Reusable conclusions are used to update the index, and a skill policy converts the revised task state into parameterized navigation actions. NavProbe achieves 71.7% SR and 55.8% SPL on R2R-CE and 55.3% SR and 38.6% SPL on RxR-CE, outperforming strong zero-shot baselines. It also achieves 79.3% SR on HM3D-v2 ObjectNav, with qualitative real-robot demonstrations illustrating physical deployment.
tldr: NavProbe introduces a hierarchical zero-shot navigation agent that uses active memory retrieval and evidence-grounded reasoning to dynamically revise subgoals, achieving state-of-the-art results on R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks and demonstrating real-robot deployment.
tldr_zh: NavProbe 提出了一种分层零样本导航智能体，通过主动记忆检索和基于证据的推理动态修订子目标，在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上取得了领先成果，并展示了真实机器人部署。
summary_zh: 长距离导航要求智能体随着证据的积累不断调整其中间目标。完整的视觉历史信息处理成本高昂，而紧凑的摘要又可能遗漏重新审视早期决策所需的细节。我们提出NavProbe，一种分层零样本导航智能体，将动态子目标议程与主动证据检索相结合。一个紧凑的索引将访问地点、过渡和地标的摘要与其视觉及几何记录相链接。当当前上下文不足时，任务执行器检索针对性证据以生成、修正或解决子目标。可复用的结论用于更新索引，技能策略将修正后的任务状态转化为参数化的导航动作。NavProbe在R2R-CE上达到71.7%的SR和55.8%的SPL，在RxR-CE上达到55.3%的SR和38.6%的SPL，优于强零样本基线。其在HM3D-v2 ObjectNav上也达到79.3%的SR，并通过定性真实机器人演示验证了物理部署的可行性。

title: Latent evolving World Action Model
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly model action generation and environment dynamics and are mostly built on pretrained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs). In VDM-based WAMs, observations are first encoded by a VAE, and the resulting compressed latents are then processed by large video diffusion backbones to extract effective features for action generation. However, this paradigm ties WAM performance and training cost to large-scale video generation pretraining, limiting WAM efficiency and scalability. In this paper, we theoretically and empirically investigate how visual representations affect action generation in WAMs. Our results show that predictive embeddings from Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) encoders better support action generation than compressed VAE latents, with I-JEPA performing best in our encoder comparison. Based on these findings, we propose LeWAM, which conditions action generation on JEPA embeddings and models environment evolution by predicting future embeddings in the same space, without relying on a video diffusion backbone. We further find that imitation learning matches demonstrated actions but does not distinguish better actions from worse ones, even though small action deviations can greatly affect task success. To address this limitation without additional environment interaction or the human oversight required for resets and safety, we introduce Demonstration-Guided DPO (DemoDPO), an offline preference refinement stage that derives preference supervision directly from demonstrations. With only 0.4B trainable parameters, LeWAM achieves an average success rate of 92.28\% on RoboTwin 2.0, comparable to that of state-of-the-art VLAs and WAMs, and maintains practical effectiveness on real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr: LeWAM replaces video diffusion backbones in World Action Models with JEPA embeddings for action generation and environment dynamics prediction, and introduces DemoDPO for offline preference refinement from demonstrations, achieving high success rates in simulation and real robot manipulation.
tldr_zh: LeWAM 提出用 JEPA 嵌入替代视频扩散主干进行动作生成和世界动态预测，并引入基于示范的离线偏好优化 DemoDPO，在仿真和真实机器人操作中取得高性能。
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）联合建模动作生成与环境动态，主要基于预训练的视频扩散模型（VDMs）构建。在基于VDM的WAMs中，观测首先由VAE编码，随后生成的压缩潜变量由大型视频扩散骨干网络处理，以提取用于动作生成的有效特征。然而，这一范式将WAM的性能和训练成本与大规模视频生成预训练绑定，限制了WAM的效率和可扩展性。本文从理论和实证两方面探究了视觉表示如何影响WAM中的动作生成。研究结果表明，来自联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）编码器的预测性嵌入比压缩VAE潜变量更有利于动作生成，其中I-JEPA在我们比较的编码器中表现最佳。基于这些发现，我们提出了LeWAM，它基于JEPA嵌入条件化动作生成，并通过在同一空间中预测未来嵌入来建模环境演化，无需依赖视频扩散骨干网络。我们进一步发现，模仿学习能够匹配演示动作，但无法区分较优动作与较差动作，即便微小的动作偏差也可能对任务成功产生显著影响。为解决这一局限，且无需额外的环境交互或重置与安全所需的人工监督，我们引入了演示引导的DPO（DemoDPO），一种离线偏好优化阶段，直接从演示中推导偏好监督信号。LeWAM仅需4亿可训练参数，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到了92.28%的平均成功率，与最先进的VLA和WAM方法相当，并在真实世界操作任务中保持了实际有效性。

title: X2Real: an eXtensive simulation benchmark for real-world generalist policies
summary: Generalist robot manipulation policies have developed rapidly, yet their reliable evaluation remains challenging due to fundamental flaws in existing simulation benchmarks: prominent sim-to-real gaps, narrow task coverage, and unfair evaluation caused by ambiguous training-test pipelines. Prior works only partially resolve these issues and lack simultaneous faithfulness, diversity, and fairness, while static benchmark designs fail to sustain long-term policy development. We present X2Real, an evolvable simulation benchmark for faithfully evaluating the real-world performance of robotic manipulation policies based on Nvidia Isaac Lab-Arena. Following three core principles (faithfulness, diversity, and fairness), X2Real calibrates simulation visual and physical properties to align with real hardware, achieving a 0.84 linear correlation between simulated and real-robot evaluation results. It features a comprehensive taxonomy with 10 capability dimensions and 44 hierarchical long-horizon tasks, covering basic manipulation skills and advanced capacities such as visual grounding, language understanding, and bimanual control. We further adopt multi-axis domain randomization and strictly disjoint training-evaluation pipelines to mitigate benchmark exploitation and ensure credible evaluation. Powered by a custom physical domain-specific language, the Mana simulation ecosystem supports modular task design and iterative performance analysis, alongside a nearly 300-hour annotated simulation trajectory dataset. X2Real offers a faithful, diverse, and fair evolving evaluation infrastructure, effectively bridging the sim-to-real evaluation gap and supporting the advancement of generalist robotic manipulation policies.
tldr: X2Real is an evolvable simulation benchmark for robotic manipulation policies, designed to faithfully evaluate real-world performance by calibrating simulation to real hardware, covering diverse long-horizon tasks, and ensuring fair evaluation via disjoint training-test pipelines.
tldr_zh: X2Real 是一个可演进的机器人操作策略仿真基准，通过校准仿真与真实硬件的对齐，覆盖多样的长时程任务，并采用分离的训练-测试流程，以忠实、多样且公平地评估真实世界性能。
summary_zh: 通用型机器人操作策略发展迅速，然而，由于现有仿真基准测试存在根本性缺陷，其可靠评估仍面临挑战：突出的仿真到现实差距、任务覆盖范围狭窄，以及由模糊的训练-测试流程所导致的不公平评估。以往的工作仅部分解决了这些问题，未能同时兼顾保真性、多样性和公平性，而静态基准测试设计也难以支撑策略的长期发展。我们提出X2Real，一个基于Nvidia Isaac Lab-Arena的可进化仿真基准测试，用于忠实地评估机器人操作策略在现实世界中的性能。遵循三大核心原则（保真性、公平性和多样性），X2Real对仿真视觉和物理属性进行校准，使其与真实硬件对齐，在仿真与真实机器人评估结果之间实现了0.84的线性相关性。它包含一个全面的分类体系，涵盖10个能力维度和44个层次化的长时程任务，覆盖基础操作技能以及视觉接地、语言理解和双臂控制等高级能力。我们进一步采用多轴域随机化和严格分离的训练-评估流程，以减轻基准测试的利用问题，确保评估的可信度。依托自定义的物理领域特定语言，Mana仿真生态系统支持模块化任务设计和迭代式性能分析，并提供近300小时的带标注仿真轨迹数据集。X2Real提供了一个保真、多样且公平的可进化评估基础设施，有效弥合了仿真到现实的评估差距，并支持通用型机器人操作策略的进步。

title: Automotive mmWave Spinning Radar Place Recognition with Spatially Gated Feature-Correlation Representation
summary: Automotive spinning FMCW radar provides dense, $360^\circ$ sensing and remains reliable under poor illumination and adverse weather, making it well-suited to autonomous navigation. Place recognition uses these observations to identify previously visited locations for re-localization and long-term navigation. However, heading changes appear as circular shifts in the polar radar representation, and conventional global aggregation can lose relationships among radar responses that are important for distinguishing similar places. We propose SGCA-Net, a spinning radar place recognition framework that combines rotation-robust feature extraction with Spatially Gated Correlation Aggregation (SGCA). SGCA learns spatial weights to reduce the influence of unstable and ambiguous radar regions, while aggregating pairwise correlations among local responses to preserve informative feature relationships. Experiments on the MulRan dataset show that SGCA-Net consistently outperforms SOTA methods across urban, campus, and open-road environments, while remaining robust to substantial heading variation. Evaluation on the HeRCULES dataset further demonstrates that SGCA-Net generalizes to unseen environments and radar sensors without fine-tuning.
tldr: SGCA-Net proposes a spinning radar place recognition framework that uses spatially gated correlation aggregation to achieve rotation-robust, state-of-the-art performance across diverse environments, improving re-localization for autonomous vehicles.
tldr_zh: SGCA-Net 提出了一种基于空间门控相关性聚合的旋转雷达地点识别框架，在不同环境下实现了最先进的性能，提升了自动驾驶车辆的重新定位能力。
summary_zh: 车载旋转调频连续波（FMCW）雷达能够提供密集的 \(360^\circ\) 感知，并且在光照不足和恶劣天气条件下依然保持可靠，非常适合自主导航应用。位置识别利用这些观测数据来识别之前访问过的地点，以支持重定位和长期导航。然而，航向变化在极坐标雷达表示中表现为循环移位，传统的全局聚合方法可能会丢失雷达响应之间对区分相似地点至关重要的关系。我们提出了 SGCA-Net，一种旋转雷达位置识别框架，它将旋转鲁棒特征提取与空间门控相关聚合（SGCA）相结合。SGCA 学习空间权重以减少不稳定和模糊雷达区域的影响，同时聚合局部响应之间的成对相关性，以保留具有信息量的特征关系。在 MulRan 数据集上的实验表明，SGCA-Net 在城市、校园和开放道路环境中始终优于最先进的方法，并且对显著的航向变化保持鲁棒性。在 HeRCULES 数据集上的评估进一步表明，SGCA-Net 无需微调即可泛化到未见过的环境和雷达传感器。

title: CoPRE: Improving Sensitivity in Proprioceptive Contact Detection for Low-Cost Robot Arms
summary: Contact detection during robotic manipulation allows robots to recognize unexpected contact and adapt their motion accordingly. However, in low-cost robot arms without dedicated force or tactile sensors, detecting weak contacts from proprioception is challenging because the resulting changes in joint-level proprioceptive signals can be small compared to normal variation and noise caused by robot motion itself. We introduce Contact-free Proprioceptive Response Estimation (CoPRE), improving proprioceptive contact detection sensitivity using only contact-free motion, without additional force sensors, contact labels, or analytical dynamics models. CoPRE estimate the expected joint torques under contact-free motion from proprioceptive state history and commanded motion, while removing recent observations that may already reflect contact. It then computes the residual between the expected and observed joint torque estimates, and maps this residual to a contact score using a noise-weighted Jacobian. Real-robot experiments on ARX Arm and Unitree G1 show that CoPRE achieves 74.1% and 82.2% recall on the tested contact trials, compared with 0%/0% on ARX and 16.3%/42.2% on G1 for the learned torque-prediction and inverse-dynamics baselines. CoPRE also reaches 90% detection rate for pushing force at 3.5 N on ARX and 5.5 N on G1. To demonstrate the downstream utility of our method, we implement belief-space manipulation planning for obstacle-aware object placement and book insertion where detected contacts update the spatial belief and enable the robot to retreat from blocked motions, adjust its pose, and retry. Project website at https://copre-arm.github.io
tldr: CoPRE improves weak contact detection in low-cost robot arms by learning expected contact-free joint torques from proprioceptive history and commanded motion, then using a noise-weighted Jacobian residual for contact scoring; real-robot experiments show high recall and sensitivity, enabling belief-space manipulation for obstacle-aware tasks.
tldr_zh: CoPRE 通过从本体感受历史和指令运动学习无接触期望关节力矩，并利用噪声加权雅可比残差进行接触评分，提高了低成本机械臂的弱接触检测灵敏度；真实机器人实验表明其具有高召回率和灵敏度，并支持信念空间操作以完成障碍物感知任务。
summary_zh: 机器人操作过程中的接触检测使机器人能够识别意外接触并相应调整其运动。然而，在未配备专用力传感器或触觉传感器的低成本机械臂中，从本体感觉中检测微弱接触具有挑战性，因为由此引起的关节级本体感觉信号变化相较于机器人自身运动产生的正常波动和噪声可能非常微小。我们提出了无接触本体感觉响应估计（CoPRE），该方法仅利用无接触运动来提高本体感觉接触检测灵敏度，无需额外的力传感器、接触标签或解析动力学模型。CoPRE 从本体感觉状态历史和指令运动中估计无接触运动下的期望关节力矩，同时剔除可能已反映接触的近期观测数据。随后，它计算期望关节力矩估计与观测关节力矩估计之间的残差，并通过噪声加权雅可比矩阵将该残差映射为接触得分。在 ARX Arm 和 Unitree G1 上进行的真实机器人实验表明，CoPRE 在测试接触试验中分别达到 74.1% 和 82.2% 的召回率，而学习的力矩预测基线和逆动力学基线在 ARX 上均为 0%/0%，在 G1 上分别为 16.3%/42.2%。CoPRE 在 ARX 上对 3.5 N 的推力、在 G1 上对 5.5 N 的推力均达到 90% 的检测率。为展示我们方法的下游应用价值，我们实现了基于置信空间的操作规划，用于障碍感知物体放置和书籍插入任务，其中检测到的接触更新空间置信度，使机器人能够从受阻运动中撤退、调整姿态并重试。项目网站：https://copre-arm.github.io

title: Reflection-Aware Reasoning for Non-Line-of-Sight Pedestrian Localization
summary: Reliable localization of non-line-of-sight (NLOS) pedestrians is critical for safe urban autonomous driving, yet it remains highly challenging in ego-dynamic outdoor environments, where ego-vehicle motion makes radar multipath propagation complex and noisy. In this paper, we present a reflection-aware framework for NLOS pedestrian localization with a moving ego-vehicle in outdoor testbed scenarios. Our framework fuses front-view camera images and 2D radar point clouds to infer reflection orders and reflective surface distributions in bird's-eye-view space. It then uses physics-guided ray tracing to reconstruct distorted reflection paths and localize the hidden pedestrian. We validate the framework in outdoor testbed scenarios under ego-dynamic conditions. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework for NLOS pedestrian localization with a moving ego-vehicle.
tldr: This paper introduces a reflection-aware framework that fuses camera and radar data to localize non-line-of-sight pedestrians in dynamic outdoor driving scenarios, using physics-guided ray tracing to reconstruct multipath reflections.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种反射感知框架，融合相机和雷达数据，利用物理引导的射线追踪重建多径反射，在动态户外驾驶场景中实现对非视距行人的定位。
summary_zh: 非视距（NLOS）行人的可靠定位对于城市环境下的安全自动驾驶至关重要，然而在自车动态的户外环境中，这一任务仍极具挑战性，因为自车运动使得雷达多径传播变得复杂且噪声显著。本文提出了一种适用于自车运动场景下户外测试环境中非视距行人定位的反射感知框架。该框架融合前视摄像头图像与二维雷达点云，在鸟瞰图空间中推断反射阶次及反射面分布，并借助物理引导的射线追踪方法重构畸变的反射路径，从而实现对隐蔽行人的定位。我们在自车动态条件下的户外测试场景中对该框架进行了验证。结果表明，该框架在自车运动情况下对非视距行人的定位具有有效性。

title: EmbodiedSWE: Coding Agents for Long Horizon Dexterous Robotics
summary: We study coding agents for long-horizon, dexterous robotics and ask whether their solutions can provide scalable supervision for learning general robot policies. To test this, we develop EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH, a simulation benchmark for coding agents spanning contact-rich manipulation, deformable objects, and long-horizon tasks requiring up to half an hour of continuous interaction. We find that frontier coding agents can solve complex long-horizon tasks and transfer prior solutions across both tasks and embodiments. We also design supporting tools that help agents more effectively solve these tasks. However, the resulting solutions require substantial iterative interaction and are typically specialized to individual task instances. We therefore introduce EMBODIEDSWE-GEN, which expands a single solution from coding agent into large diverse trajectories for training a VLA. VLA performance improves with more generated demonstrations, and agent-aided diversification improves generalization to held-out task variations. We also show that a VLA finetuned solely on coding-agent-generated simulation demonstrations completes a long-horizon task on real robot. Together, our framework uses coding agents to solve complex robotics tasks and turn verified solutions into scalable supervision for robot policies.
tldr: This paper introduces EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH, a simulation benchmark for evaluating coding agents on long-horizon dexterous robotics tasks, and EMBODIEDSWE-GEN, a framework that uses coding-agent-generated demonstrations to train vision-language-action (VLA) models. Experiments show that VLA policies trained on these generated demonstrations can complete a long-horizon task on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH，一个用于评估编码代理在长时间跨度的灵巧机器人任务上的模拟基准，以及EMBODIEDSWE-GEN，一个利用编码代理生成的演示来训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的框架。实验表明，基于这些生成演示训练的VLA策略可以在真实机器人上完成长时间跨度的任务。
summary_zh: 摘要：我们研究用于长时程、灵巧机器人操作的编程智能体，并探讨其解决方案能否为学习通用机器人策略提供可扩展的监督信号。为验证这一设想，我们开发了EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH，一个面向编程智能体的仿真基准平台，涵盖接触丰富的操作、可变形物体以及需要长达半小时连续交互的长时程任务。我们发现，前沿编程智能体能够解决复杂的长时程任务，并将先前解决方案跨任务和跨实体进行迁移。我们还设计了辅助工具，帮助智能体更有效地解决这些任务。然而，所得解决方案需要大量的迭代交互，且通常针对单个任务实例进行专门化。因此，我们引入EMBODIEDSWE-GEN，将编程智能体的单一解决方案扩展为大规模多样化轨迹，用于训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。随着生成的示范数据增多，VLA性能随之提升，且智能体辅助的多样化策略增强了对未见过任务变体的泛化能力。我们还证明，仅使用编程智能体生成的仿真示范进行微调的VLA模型，能够在真实机器人上完成长时程任务。综上，我们的框架利用编程智能体解决复杂机器人任务，并将验证后的解决方案转化为机器人策略的可扩展监督信号。

title: BranchDrive: A Branch-Structured Dataset for Action-Conditioned Driving Prediction
summary: Most autonomous-driving datasets record only the action executed by a behavior policy and the single future that followed, providing limited supervision for comparing alternative ego decisions. We introduce BranchDrive, a branch-structured CARLA dataset and benchmark that pairs one canonical pre-decision history with one nominal expert future and twelve physically executed intervention futures spanning acceleration, braking, and left- and right-steering policies at three magnitudes. Each intervention lasts 2.5 s and is followed by expert recovery. Following control-compliance, modality-completeness, replay-fidelity, and action-leakage audits, the frozen benchmark contains 606 independent branch groups and 7,878 associated trajectories. We evaluate prediction of six continuous short-horizon outcomes and a ten-step ego trajectory using action-only, history-only, structured, visual, multimodal, and privileged bird's-eye-view models. On the held-out test split, the structured history-and-action model achieves a macro normalized mean absolute error of 0.5036 and an average displacement error of 2.2042 m, significantly outperforming both restricted baselines. In full-information offline evaluation, its outcome-derived selector increases balanced policy value from 0.5364 to 0.5704 and reduces normalized regret from 0.2674 to 0.1495 relative to the frozen action prior. However, a validation-calibrated minimum-separation guard rejects every intervention, showing that conservative execution remains unresolved. BranchDrive therefore supports action-conditioned short-horizon prediction and fixed-bank offline decision evaluation, but does not establish exact causal effects, binary safety prediction, or closed-loop safety improvement.
tldr: This paper introduces BranchDrive, a branch-structured CARLA driving dataset and benchmark pairing one history with multiple physically executed intervention futures for action-conditioned prediction and offline decision evaluation. It evaluates various prediction models, showing structured history-action models improve outcomes but conservative execution remains unsolved.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了BranchDrive，一个基于CARLA的分支结构驾驶数据集和基准，将一段历史与多个物理执行干预未来配对，用于动作条件预测和离线决策评估。评估了多种预测模型，表明结构化历史-动作模型可改善效果，但保守执行问题仍未解决。
summary_zh: 大多数自动驾驶数据集仅记录了行为策略所执行的动作以及随之而来的单一未来结果，为比较不同自车决策提供的监督信息十分有限。我们提出了BranchDrive——一个分支结构的CARLA数据集与基准，将一条规范的事前决策历史与一条名义上的专家未来轨迹以及十二条物理执行干预未来轨迹配对，这些干预涵盖三种强度下的加速、制动、左转向和右转向策略。每次干预持续2.5秒，随后由专家策略进行恢复。经过控制合规性、模态完整性、回放保真度和动作泄漏审计后，冻结基准包含606个独立分支组和7,878条关联轨迹。我们评估了六个连续短期结果和一条十步自车轨迹的预测性能，使用了仅动作、仅历史、结构化、视觉、多模态和特权鸟瞰图模型。在保留测试集上，结构化历史-动作模型实现了宏观归一化平均绝对误差0.5036和平均位移误差2.2042米，显著优于受限基线模型。在完全信息的离线评估中，其基于结果的选取器将平衡策略值从0.5364提升至0.5704，并将相对于冻结动作先验的归一化遗憾从0.2674降至0.1495。然而，经过验证集校准的最小间隔保护机制拒绝了所有干预，表明保守执行问题仍未解决。因此，BranchDrive支持动作条件短期预测和固定库离线决策评估，但尚不能确立精确因果效应、二值安全预测或闭环安全改进。

title: Banana Kick: Response-Informed Skill Evolution for Humanoid Soccer
summary: Humanoid kicking requires coordinated whole-body motion and precise contact, while a banana kick demands contact mechanics that generate ball spin and aerodynamic curvature. Motion imitation provides a reliable ordinary-kick prior, but reinforcement learning may improve shot speed and placement accuracy without changing the underlying kicking technique. Adapting this prior to a qualitatively different contact-rich skill can fail even when the reward is dense and optimization remains stable. The failure occurs when the task objective is locally flat over the current policy's responses. We term this condition first-order learning starvation. To address it, we propose response-informed skill evolution (RISE), a closed-loop objective-continuation method for policy adaptation. RISE ranks bounded objective changes using response sensitivity estimated from cached rollouts and accepts updates only when they produce verified response progress while preserving kicking reliability. Our analysis shows that rescaling a saturated spin reward cannot recover first-order sensitivity at zero spin, whereas adapting coupled contact responses can provide a learnable path to spin generation. We integrate RISE into a humanoid kicking pipeline under calibrated contact and Magnus-force aerodynamics, and sim-to-real transfer. Experiments show that RISE evolves the ordinary kick into a high-spin curved kick with 11.55 rad/s mean ball spin, improves the mean evaluation score by 19.8% over a learning-progress curriculum, and raises joint target attainment from 15.2% to 50.9%. Ablations and response diagnostics support the mechanism, while 30 motion-capture-recorded physical trials demonstrate consistent hardware transfer of the learned curved kick. Project website: https://haozhang-thu.github.io/bananakick/
tldr: This paper introduces RISE, a closed-loop objective-continuation method for adapting an ordinary humanoid kick into a high-spin banana kick via reinforcement learning, addressing local flatness in reward via response sensitivity and achieving robust sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RISE，一种闭环目标延拓方法，用于将人形机器人普通踢球策略进化为高旋香蕉球技能，通过响应灵敏度应对奖励局部平坦问题，并实现可靠的仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh: 仿人踢球需要全身协调运动与精确接触，而香蕉球则要求产生球旋转及空气动力学弯曲的接触力学。运动模仿提供了可靠的常规踢球先验，但强化学习可以在不改变底层踢球技术的前提下提升射门速度与落点精度。将该先验迁移至定性不同的接触密集型技能时，即使奖励稠密且优化过程保持稳定，仍可能失败。当任务目标在当前策略的响应空间上局部平坦时，便会出现此类失败。我们将这一条件称为一阶学习饥饿。为解决该问题，我们提出响应知情技能演化（RISE），一种用于策略自适应的闭环目标延拓方法。RISE利用从缓存轨迹中估计的响应敏感性对有界目标变化进行排序，且仅在更新能产生已验证的响应进展并保持踢球可靠性的情况下接受更新。分析表明，对饱和的自旋奖励进行重新缩放无法在零自旋处恢复一阶敏感性，而适配耦合的接触响应可为自旋生成提供可学习的路径。我们将RISE集成至校准接触与马格努斯力空气动力学条件下的仿人踢球流程，并实现仿真到现实的迁移。实验表明，RISE将常规踢球演化为高自旋弧线球，平均球转速达11.55 rad/s，平均评估分数较学习进度课程提升19.8%，关节目标达成率由15.2%提升至50.9%。消融实验与响应诊断支持该机制的有效性，30次动作捕捉记录的实物试验则验证了所学弧线球在硬件上的一致迁移。项目网站：https://haozhang-thu.github.io/bananakick/

title: The Gaussian Is Enough: Flow-Matching Priors Do Not Help When Fine-Tuning Large Behavior Models
summary: Modern robot imitation learning increasingly relies on generative policies based on diffusion or flow-matching models, which generate actions by transforming samples from a prior distribution. A key question is whether the choice of prior matters. Replacing the standard Gaussian with a closer-to-target, non-Gaussian prior has been shown to substantially improve performance when training from scratch. A natural next step is to ask whether these gains transfer to fine-tuning pretrained Large Behavior Models (LBMs) such as LBM 1.0, $π_{0.5}$, and GR00T~N1.5, where one might expect even larger gains. Surprisingly, we find that this is not the case, except possibly at very low fine-tuning data fractions. Across over 100K simulation rollouts spanning all three aforementioned LBMs on 40+ tasks in two simulation platforms, and 1250 hardware rollouts on five bimanual manipulation tasks, non-Gaussian priors that are demonstrably closer to the target yield statistically indistinguishable or worse fine-tuning performance than a standard Gaussian prior. Diagnostic analyses suggest why: fine-tuned imitation learning policies converge to similar action predictions across priors, despite their fine-tuned encoder embeddings diverging substantially from the pretrained embeddings and each other. A learning-rate ablation further confirms that encoder training is the dominant factor in fine-tuning performance, substantially outweighing the effect of prior choice. We conclude with concrete directions for future research on when and why learned priors might still matter in fine-tuning. Project page: https://cxu-tri.github.io/non_gaussian_FT/
tldr: This paper investigates whether using non-Gaussian priors in flow-matching policies improves fine-tuning of large behavior models (LBMs) for robot imitation learning, finding no benefit over Gaussian priors across extensive simulations and real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在微调大型行为模型（LBM）进行机器人模仿学习时，使用非高斯先验是否可以改善性能，结果表明在大量仿真和真实机器人实验中，非高斯先验相比高斯先验没有优势。
summary_zh: 现代机器人模仿学习日益依赖于基于扩散或流匹配模型的生成式策略，这些策略通过从先验分布中变换样本来生成动作。一个关键问题是先验的选择是否重要。已有研究表明，在从头训练时，用更接近目标分布的非高斯先验替代标准高斯先验能够显著提升性能。自然的下一步是探究这些收益能否迁移到对预训练大型行为模型（LBMs）如LBM 1.0、$π_{0.5}$和GR00T~N1.5的微调中，在这种情况下或许预期能获得更大的收益。令人意外的是，我们发现情况并非如此，除非在极低微调数据比例的场景下。在跨越上述三种LBM、覆盖两个仿真平台中40余项任务的超过10万次仿真 rollout，以及五项双臂操作任务上的1250次硬件 rollout中，被证明更接近目标分布的非高斯先验在微调性能上与标准高斯先验相比，统计上无显著差异或表现更差。诊断性分析揭示了可能的原因：尽管微调后的编码器嵌入与预训练嵌入及彼此之间产生显著分歧，微调后的模仿学习策略在不同先验下仍会收敛到相似的动作预测。进一步的学习率消融实验证实，编码器训练是微调性能的主导因素，其影响远超先验选择的作用。最后，我们为未来研究“学习到的先验在何种情况下以及为何仍可能在微调中发挥作用”提出了具体方向。项目页面：https://cxu-tri.github.io/non_gaussian_FT/

title: Learning Expressive Humanoid Locomotion from Monocular Runway Videos for Robot Fashion Shows
summary: Runway walking requires coordinated control of posture, stride, foot placement, and whole-body motion to effectively present clothing and convey a distinctive style. However, humanoid robots used in fashion shows typically rely on locomotion policies optimized primarily for stability and walking speed, limiting their ability to reproduce expressive, human-like runway motions. In this work, we present an end-to-end framework that transforms monocular runway videos into deployable humanoid locomotion policies through motion recovery, robot retargeting, motion correction, policy training, simulation-based evaluation, and physical deployment. We evaluate the proposed framework on the Booster K1 humanoid robot using runway-style catwalk motions. The learned policy completed every physical trial without falling, while reproducing the characteristic narrow foot placement and coordinated movement of the legs, torso, and arms. The results demonstrate that our proposed training framework enables the Booster K1 to perform stable and expressive catwalk motions, highlighting its potential for humanoid robotic applications in fashion shows and other performance-oriented scenarios.
tldr: This paper presents an end-to-end framework to transfer expressive runway walking from monocular videos to a humanoid robot, enabling stable and stylish catwalk locomotion for fashion shows.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个端到端框架，将单目视频中的走秀步态迁移到人形机器人上，使其能够稳定且富有表现力地行走。
summary_zh: 摘要：T台行走需要对姿态、步幅、落脚位置及全身运动进行协调控制，以有效展示服装并传达独特风格。然而，用于时装秀的人形机器人通常依赖主要针对稳定性和行走速度进行优化的运动策略，这限制了其再现富有表现力、类人化T台动作的能力。在本工作中，我们提出了一种端到端框架，通过动作恢复、机器人重定向、动作修正、策略训练、基于仿真的评估及物理部署，将单目T台视频转化为可部署的人形机器人运动策略。我们使用T台风格猫步动作在Booster K1人形机器人上对所提框架进行了评估。学习得到的策略在所有物理试验中均未摔倒，同时再现了特征性的窄落脚间距以及腿、躯干和手臂的协调运动。结果表明，我们所提出的训练框架使Booster K1能够执行稳定且富有表现力的猫步动作，凸显了其在时装秀及其他表演导向场景中的人形机器人应用潜力。

title: AnchorReasoning: A Visual Grounding and Causal Reasoning Dataset in Long-Tail Autonomous Driving Scenarios
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising approach to long-tail autonomous driving, but existing driving datasets provide limited supervision for connecting decision-critical visual evidence with reasoning and planning. We introduce AnchorReasoning, a visually grounded reasoning dataset built on WOD-E2E, containing 416,119 annotated frames and 395,379 decision-critical elements across four major categories and 19 fine-grained types. Each frame is organized as a visually grounded chain-of-thought (VG-CoT) that links decision-critical element identification and localization, element attributes and implications, driving-action rationale, and action and trajectory planning. We further develop a curriculum supervised fine-tuning strategy that progressively learns these hierarchical capabilities, together with an object-size-aware grounding metric for evaluating localization quality. Experiments across eight general-purpose, embodied-AI, and AV-specific backbones show that VG-CoT supervision improves grounded reasoning and trajectory prediction. Across models, 5-s ADE and FDE decrease by 7.84 and 11.86, while RFS Frame and Cluster improve by 1.66 and 1.70. These gains are achieved with 18.5 fewer reasoning tokens and 0.32 s/frame lower inference latency on average, demonstrating the value of visually grounded, decision-focused supervision for VLM reasoning and planning in long-tail autonomous driving.
tldr: Introduces AnchorReasoning, a visually grounded reasoning dataset for long-tail autonomous driving with VG-CoT supervision that improves VLM reasoning and trajectory prediction while reducing reasoning tokens and latency.
tldr_zh: 提出了 AnchorReasoning，一个用于长尾自动驾驶的视觉接地推理数据集，通过 VG-CoT 监督改进 VLM 推理与轨迹预测，同时减少推理 token 和延迟。
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）为长尾自动驾驶提供了一种有前景的解决方案，但现有驾驶数据集在将决策关键视觉证据与推理和规划相连接方面提供的监督信息有限。我们引入了AnchorReasoning，这是一个基于WOD-E2E构建的视觉接地推理数据集，包含416,119个标注帧和395,379个决策关键要素，涵盖四个主要类别和19种细粒度类型。每个帧被组织为一条视觉接地思维链（VG-CoT），将决策关键要素的识别与定位、要素属性与含义、驾驶行为依据以及动作与轨迹规划相连接。我们进一步开发了一种课程式监督微调策略，逐步学习这些层级化能力，同时引入了一种面向对象尺寸的接地度量指标来评估定位质量。在八个通用、具身AI及自动驾驶专用骨干模型上的实验表明，VG-CoT监督提升了接地推理和轨迹预测性能。在各模型中，5秒ADE和FDE分别降低了7.84和11.86，而RFS Frame和Cluster分别提升了1.66和1.70。这些性能提升平均仅需减少18.5个推理令牌和0.32秒/帧的推理延迟，充分证明了视觉接地、决策聚焦的监督方式对VLM在长尾自动驾驶中推理与规划能力的价值。

title: Where Should I Join? Robot Group Joining via Language-Guided Goal Prediction
summary: Social navigation typically assumes a specified goal and focuses on reaching it while respecting social conventions, whereas robot group joining requires predicting where to join based on the group's real-time activity and formation. This is a highly semantic task, yet an important capability for applications such as robotic guide dogs and autonomous mobility scooters. We formulate language-grounded robot group joining: given an observation and a natural-language description of a target group, the robot identifies the relevant group members and predicts socially compliant joining poses. For grounding, we generate structured candidate subsets through recursive spectral partitioning and rank them with a language-conditioned image--geometry model. Given the grounded group, a goal predictor leverages human-formation priors to produce a multimodal energy--orientation map over feasible robot poses. Experiments on conversations, queues, and audiences across varying group sizes, crowd densities, and visual ambiguities show that our method achieves competitive grounding accuracy with sub-second inference and outperforms all baselines in joining-pose prediction. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate group joining in both static and dynamically changing interactions.
tldr: This paper introduces a language-guided robot group joining method that predicts socially compliant joining poses by grounding target groups via recursive spectral partitioning and a language-conditioned image-geometry model, validated in real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种语言引导的机器人加入群体方法，通过递归谱划分和语言条件图像-几何模型定位目标群体，并预测符合社交规范的加入姿态，在真实机器人上得到验证。
summary_zh: 社交导航通常假定存在一个明确目标，并侧重于在遵循社会规范的前提下到达该目标，而机器人加入群体则要求根据群体的实时活动与队形预测加入位置。这是一项高度语义化的任务，但对于导盲机器人和自主移动代步车等应用而言却是一项重要能力。我们提出了基于语言引导的机器人群体加入方法：给定一段观测信息以及关于目标群体的自然语言描述，机器人识别相关群体成员，并预测符合社交规范的加入姿态。为实现语言 grounding，我们通过递归谱划分生成结构化候选子集，并使用语言条件化的图像—几何模型对其进行排序。在确定目标群体后，一个目标预测器利用人类队形先验，生成关于可行机器人姿态的多模态能量—方向图。我们在不同群体规模、人群密度和视觉模糊条件下的对话、队列和观众场景中进行了实验，结果表明，我们的方法在 grounding 准确率上具有竞争力，推理时间低于秒级，并且在加入姿态预测方面优于所有基线方法。真实机器人实验进一步验证了该方法在静态和动态变化的交互场景中均能实现群体加入。

title: Frozen Flows Forget: Diagnosing and Restoring Lost Motion in a Latent-flow World Model
summary: Latent world models that integrate a flow in a frozen self supervised latent space train stably and cheaply, yet silently lose the property manipulation depends on most: motion. The pretrained flow never moves the manipulated object; retraining it with latent-only losses only trades stillness for teleport-like motion. We trace the failure to the training signal, not the representation: anchor-sparse, latent-only supervision never says where along the horizon change belongs. Decode-augmented rollout training (DART) repairs this while keeping the representation frozen, retraining only the flow with decode-path supervision.
